title: Fourier coefficients of degree truncation
statement: Let $n,k\ge 0$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $T$ be a set of coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the degree-$k$ truncation of $f$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $T$ when $|T|\le k$, and equals $0$ when $|T|>k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
